premises.text: Medical tourism is dominated by travel agents who lack clinical expertise, yielding unvetted doctors and poor trust

premises.text: Patients travel for care to save money, save time, or gain access to procedures unavailable at home
premises.evidence_span: three main reasons patients travel for medical care. The first is to save money

premises.text: An online marketplace connects American and Canadian patients with English-speaking, board-certified, top-rated doctors abroad

premises.text: Doctors undergo strict physician-board vetting with a low acceptance rate, HIPAA-compliant communication, and marketplace-handled admin and payments

premises.text: Launch destinations begin with Mexico, Costa Rica, and the Cayman Islands with transparent pricing

value.text: Transparent, secure, trusted access to world-class medical care abroad
